Library Current students Staff Portal Giving Contact us Compare degrees Search Research degree opportunities Study at a global top 100 university* Home Research Research degree opportunities Research Research degrees at Adelaide University Research drives advancement in our society and in our industries, generating new insights and sparking innovation. Human progress is powered by curious and hard-working people – just like you. Whether you want to establish yourself as a thought leader in your field, leverage your expertise to win more specialised or high-paying roles, or transform research findings into innovative products or practices, earning a research degree unlocks a world of opportunities. Throughout this journey, Adelaide University will support you to pursue your ideas and breakthroughs. Applications for research degrees are now open. You can explore the types of degrees available, discover our diverse range of research projects, or search for a potential supervisor. Not sure where to start? Make an enquiry and our Future Student Enquiry Team can help you. Graduate Research Talent Scheme Scholarship Round Designed to recognise academic excellence, research achievement and future research potential, this scholarship supports high-performing graduate researchers across all research disciplines. To be eligible for this competitive scholarship round, you must be a domestic applicant, or an international applicant who has completed a relevant Australian or New Zealand qualification.
